name: Wheel of Heaven Flood-Myth Concordance
description: Eleven textual flood accounts with 88 passage-level observations, evidence states, named editions and qualified chronology. Row count is not evidence of a shared event.
row_unit: An inspected textual account at a named edition and bounded scope; legacy IDs retained for reconciliation.

state_definitions.attested: Feature stated in the selected translation; not proof of the narrated event.
state_definitions.not_stated: Inspected scope makes no statement; not a demonstrated absence across a whole tradition.
state_definitions.text_damaged: Gaps or excerpt lacunae block a determination; does not assert the feature occupied the gap.
state_definitions.uncertain: Reading or attribution remains qualified in the inspected representation.
state_definitions.explicitly_absent: Source explicitly denies the feature; requires a cited denial. No current cell uses this state.

chronology_policy: Composition, physical witness, internal textual date and proposed historical event date are distinct. Edition/translation provenance is recorded through edition_source_ids and the source register. Legacy dates are retained for comparison, not endorsed.

chronology_state_definitions.not_reassessed: Inherited composition date has not been independently supported in this audit.
chronology_state_definitions.not_established: No date for a physical witness has been established by the inspected sources.
chronology_state_definitions.not_audited: Internal textual chronology has not been systematically inspected; no absence claim.
chronology_state_definitions.not_assigned: No historical event date is asserted.
chronology_state_definitions.catalogue_estimate: A collection catalogue supplies an approximate physical-witness date.
chronology_state_definitions.colophon_attested: The inspected edition translates a dating formula in the witness colophon.
chronology_state_definitions.edition_estimate: The inspected editor proposes a date; this is a report of that argument, not present consensus.
chronology_state_definitions.editor_report: The inspected editor reports manuscript dates; no direct manuscript dating is performed.
chronology_state_definitions.text_attested: The inspected text states this date; its relation to composition or surviving copy is not assumed.

compatibility: The first 13 columns and account IDs are retained. Unknown observations now carry explicit labels and states. approx_date contains only a qualified composition estimate or an explicit unresolved label; former mixed dates remain unendorsed in legacy_date. JSON observations preserve nulls; CSV chronology is JSON-encoded.

review.scope: Selected-source verification of all 88 observations and five positive chronology entries; not original-language collation or historical-event verification.
review.limitations: Ten composition dates remain unreassessed. Source adaptations and restorations are disclosed; related textual streams are not independent evidence.

sources.title: The Sumerians: Their History, Culture, and Character

relationships.note: Existing core treats these as a related stream for independence control. This audit does not establish a direct linear transmission route or count independent events.
Berossus is read through the excerpt preserved in Syncellus. Reprints of that excerpt are not independent witnesses. Full Alexander Polyhistor/Eusebius/Syncellus transmission collation remains open.
Snorri introduces verse after his prose account. This inspection supplies one source, not independent prose and poetic confirmations.
The legacy row cites Betanzos and Molina together. This revision represents Molina only; a separate Betanzos observation requires an inspected edition.
Comparable Noah narratives are recorded. A direct borrowing route from this Genesis text to this Qur’anic passage has not been established here.
